items.title: Sections over a quasi-compact object commute with coproducts and direct sums
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-modules.tex (Modules on Sites)
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file sites-modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a quasi-compact object W of a site, the functor taking sections over W commutes with coproducts of sheaves of sets and with direct sums of modules. The proof rewrites a coproduct over an index set as the filtered colimit over the partially ordered set of finite subsets of the finite coproducts, whose transition maps are injective, and applies the known commutation of sections over a quasi-compact object with filtered colimits having injective transition maps (proof lines 5350-5377). The module case is handled the same way, using that a filtered colimit of abelian sheaves may be computed on sections. H2: the reduction of an arbitrary coproduct to a filtered colimit of finite ones, and the appeal to the directed-colimit lemma, are the substance.
